files.source: Biopython 1.85, installed at /usr/local/lib/python3.11/dist-packages/Bio/SeqFeature.py. Authority for in-memory location semantics: SimpleLocation's 0-based half-open coordinates ('a GenBank entry of 123..150 (one based counting) becomes a location of [122:150]'), strand, CompoundLocation and its `parts`/`operator`, BeforePosition/AfterPosition for `<`/`>`, and `extract()` — the oracle the coords tests call.

Biopython 1.85, installed at /usr/local/lib/python3.11/dist-packages/Bio/SeqIO/InsdcIO.py. Authority for writing a location back out: `_insdc_location_string` turns 0-based half-open intervals into 1-based inclusive GenBank/EMBL strings, emits `complement(join(...))` for an all-minus CompoundLocation by reversing the part list, and renders BeforePosition/AfterPosition as `<`/`>`.

Biopython 1.85, installed at /usr/local/lib/python3.11/dist-packages/Bio/GenBank/__init__.py. Authority for reading a location string: the `_FeatureConsumer.location` consumer that turns `join(...)`, `order(...)`, `complement(...)`, `<`/`>` and `accession:start..end` into SimpleLocation/CompoundLocation objects. This is the code the subject's `read_genbank`/`read_embl` delegate to before flattening the result into its own `Annotation` model.

The INSDC Feature Table Definition (DDBJ/ENA/GenBank Feature Table Definition), version current at retrieval, fetched once from https://ftp.EBI.ac.uk/pub/databases/embl/doc/FT_current.txt and saved byte-for-byte. Section 3.4.2/3.4.3 is the authority for location syntax and meaning: `join` vs `order`, `complement`, `<`/`>` partial boundaries, `123^124` between-positions, remote references `J00194.1:100..202`, and the origin-spanning `join(2004..2195,3..20)` on a circular entry.

files.source: Pinned TEST INPUT, not an oracle: RefSeq NC_001699.1 (JC polyomavirus, complete genome, 5130 bp, circular), fetched once from NCBI E-utilities efetch (db=nuccore, rettype=gbwithparts, retmode=text) and saved byte-for-byte. Chosen because one real record carries every hard location form at once: an origin-spanning `join(5118..5130,1..12)` on a circular molecule, a spliced reverse-strand `complement(join(2603..4426,4771..5013))`, a partial boundary on the reverse strand `complement(<2603..4426)`, and 24 plain features to hold the arithmetic honest.
files.license: GenBank/RefSeq record — public domain (NCBI places GenBank records in the public domain; RefSeq records carry no copyright restrictions, https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/home/about/policies/).

files.source: Pinned TEST INPUT, not an oracle: GenBank AF071878.1 (Beak and feather disease virus, complete genome, 1993 bp, circular), fetched once from NCBI E-utilities efetch (db=nuccore, rettype=gbwithparts, retmode=text) and saved byte-for-byte. The GenBank half of a real GenBank/EMBL pair for one INSDC record; carries `join(1975..1993,1..19)` across the origin, `<108..1007`, and `complement(1240..>1974)`.
files.license: GenBank record — public domain (NCBI places GenBank records in the public domain).

files.source: Pinned TEST INPUT, not an oracle: the SAME INSDC record AF071878.1 as served by ENA in EMBL flat-file format, fetched once from https://www.ebi.ac.uk/ena/browser/api/embl/AF071878?lineLimit=0 and saved byte-for-byte. Independent of the GenBank copy — it is EBI's own serialisation, not something this repo generated — so the two files together test that the subject's EMBL and GenBank readers describe one molecule identically. Note the two archives differ in content by design: ENA does not carry the `gene` features NCBI adds, so agreement is asserted over the feature keys both files contain.
